name: idea-vault
description: Summarize ideas discussed in ChatGPT, maintain idea and discussion summaries, and save or resume them through an existing GitHub connection only on explicit user request.

interface.shortDescription: Save and revisit ideas discussed in ChatGPT
interface.longDescription: Summarize the current state of an idea and its discussion history into separate Markdown files. With an authorized GitHub connection, explicitly requested changes can be committed to a user-selected repository.
defaultPrompt: このアイデアを要約して
このアイデアをGitHubに保存して
GitHubに保存したアイデアの議論を再開したい
